title: Recycled Nylon - Lining
description:
RUDSAK's recycled lining fabric is lightweight, extremely soft to the touch and provides a comfortable stretch feature. The recycled nylon is coated with a light cire finish providing a water resistant feature.


In fact, it is woven from 100% recycled nylon fibers from waste yarns, which reduces gas emissions stemming from the manufacturing process, while capitalizing on abandoned material which would have alternately ended up in landfills. The stringent manufacturing process guarantees the highest quality in recycled fibers while minimizing our environmental footprint. Not only can recycled nylon be repeatedly recycled, but it also this process necessitates less water and energy than is required for the production of virgin fabrics.

title: Recycled Nylon - Liquid Gloss
description:
RUDSAK's Liquid Gloss has a sleek and sophisticated shine finish and is designed with sustainability in mind, while delivering a luxe, light-weight, high performance and contemporary garment.


Made from 100% high quality recycled nylon fibers sourced from pre-consumer factory waste and other post-consumer recycled textiles and ocean plastics. This recycling process allows a lower environmental impact that minimizes land, air and water pollution.


The stringent manufacturing process guarantees the highest quality in recycled fibers while minimizing our environmental footprint. Not only can recycled nylon be repeatedly recycled, but it also this process necessitates less water and energy than is required for the production of virgin fabrics.

title: Recycled Nylon - Semi Gloss
description:
RUDSAK's Semi Gloss fabric delivers a lightweight, soft-to-the-touch fabric with a lustrous finish, with water-repellant and down-proof performance features. This partly recycled fabric provides thorough protection against the elements as per its wind-resistant feature. 


It is made from 48% recycled nylon and 52% nylon. We are constantly working on decreasing the percentage of virgin nylon we are using in our textiles,  significantly lowering the carbon footprint and reducing greenhouse gas emissions stemming from the manufacturing process..

title: Recycled Polyester - Mechanical Stretch
description:
Stretchy and comfortable, our mechanical stretch fabric delivers on wind and water resistance and possesses enhanced breathability for utmost performance.


The face of RUDSAK's mechanical stretch fabric is made from 100% recycled polyester and the backing is made of 90% recycled polyester and 10% TPU, while produced from a GRS certified mill. The fabrication of recycled polyester comes at a lower environmental cost as it reduces our reliance on petroleum as a source of raw materials. In fact, each ton of finished PET yarn can save up 6 tons of petroleum while considerably reducing plastic waste.

title: Recycled Polyester - Memory Fabric
description:
Durable and lightweight, RUDSAK's memory fabric delivers on key technical garment features, providing wind and water resistance. 


RUDSAK's memory fabric is woven from 100% recycled polyester sourced from discarded plastic materials, preventing used plastic from ending up in our landfills and oceans. Using recycled polyester helps reduce the environmental impact that is linked with the use of virgin polyester which is derived from petroleum.

title: Recycled Polyester - Semi Gloss
description:
A lightweight, soft-to-the-touch fabric with a lustrous finish, that is also waterproof and down-proof. It offers thorough protection against the elements while being environmentally friendly.


Our Recycled Semi Gloss fabric is made from 100% recycled polyester coupled with a cire coating that provides a luxurious shiny and smooth high quality finish. Using 100% recycled fibers is a step towards combating raw material consumption, reducing the burden on our planet and its environment.

title: Recycled Polyester - Storm Shell
description:
RUDSAK's recycled storm shell fabric features a stretch property for utmost comfort and flexibility while providing superior protection with its wind and water resistant technical properties.


This recycled fabric is made from 100% recycled polyester. Using recycled polyester generates significantly less carbon emissions, hence reducing the environmental impact that is linked with the use of virgin polyester which is derived from petroleum.
